title: BSC Audit Engine: Fail-Closed Audit-Descent Kernel
description: Version 0.3.0-alpha.11 is a public research preview of a fail-closed structural checker for typed scientific claims. It adds an exact rational short-exact-sequence certificate that binds an observed quotient to its declared null subcomplex and rejects hidden over-quotienting. It also keeps theorem gates unrun and theorem promotion blocked when a proof-like file is merely hash-matched without supervised semantic replay. The v0.1 and v0.2 holonomy contracts are validated separately so fields cannot cross version boundaries and be silently ignored. The public GPT remains a separately observed living interface; this release regenerates its repository package as an unvalidated candidate and does not claim a live update or byte-identical indexed Knowledge binding. The package adds no Action or verification API. ChatGPT uploads are processed under the user's applicable terms and settings and are not local-only. A clear run means only that no implemented blocking condition fired on the declared input. This metadata applies to the Apache-2.0 software release assets; research material under research/ is separately governed by CC BY 4.0.
